test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

One should keep ____ surroundings neat and tidy.
solution:
The correct answer is '**one's**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**one's**" is a possessive form used to refer to something belonging to a person in general. (स्वयं का)
 
• It is used to maintain a formal and neutral tone in general statements.
 
• The other options: "**there's**" (contraction of there is), "**there**" (referring to a place), and "**ones**" (plural form of one) do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *One should keep one's__ surroundings neat and tidy.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **There's (there is)**: a contraction used to indicate existence of something.
 
• **There**: used to refer to a place or position.
 
• **Ones**: plural form of one, used to refer to multiple items or people.
